=== Color templates ===
* {{tl|Background color}} ''or'' {{tl|bg}} - sets background color
* {{tl|Color}} ''or'' {{tl|Red}} etc. – sets text color
* {{tl|Colored link}} – sets link color
* {{tl|Font color}} – sets both text and background color
